name: calendar
description: Calendar files for your agent: events, deadlines and plans as an .ics file (iCalendar) that Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar import, with your time zone, all-day events, repetitions and reminders, written on your computer and read back.

interface.shortDescription: Your AI agent puts your dates in a calendar file, ready to import.
interface.longDescription: Calendar files for your agent: events, deadlines and plans as an .ics file (iCalendar) that Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar import, with your time zone, all-day events, repetitions and reminders, written on your computer and read back.
defaultPrompt: Make an .ics with my Tuesday and Thursday classes from 15 September to 18 December, 10:00 to 11:30, except the week of 2 November.
Put the unit's three deadlines in a calendar file, each with a reminder a week and a day before.
Turn my study plan for the exams into a calendar I can import into Google Calendar.
